newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-PSG WIN AT LAST IN INCIDENT-MARRED MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PSG WIN AT LAST IN INCIDENT-MARRED MATCH.

text.p: Paris St Germain scored their first league victory in nearly three months, winning 2-1 at Lens in a match marred by crowd trouble on Thursday.
The game was interrupted in the 67th minute when a linesman was knocked out by a missile thrown from a section of the stands occupied by Lens fans.
He was taken away on a stretcher, but returned after 10 minutes and the match restarted.
The incident will be the subject of an inquiry by French league officials and could lead to Lens being banned from playing one or several matches in their stadium.
Aboubacar Camara put Lens in front after 23 minutes but PSG fought their way back with a Patrice Loko goal in the 53rd minute.
Brazilian Rai gave the visitors maximum points with a brilliant header in the 65th minute.
PSG, ending a worrying streak of five league matches without a win, closed the gap on leaders Monaco to four points. Monaco are at home to Le Havre on Friday.
